orgs.philosophy: Design engineers own UI end to end and ship it themselves, so craft survives into production. Product UI is keyboard-first (Cmd+K, chorded shortcuts), fast, dense and dark-mode-native, with the 'Linear look' of subtle gradients, glass, grain, tight Inter-style type and restrained, purposeful motion. The Linear Method frames this as opinionated, focused building with high quality bars.

orgs.philosophy: Polish is a dedicated team function, not an afterthought: a craft team sweeps edges, transitions and copy across the product. Everything is a block, editing is direct and forgiving (slash menu, drag handles, nesting), and delight comes from small micro-interactions and thoughtful empty states that teach the product.
